name: cinelanding
description: Agent toolkit for building cinematic scroll-driven landing pages with KIE.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Build cinematic landing pages with an agent.
interface.longDescription: CineLanding gives coding agents a safe, repeatable workflow for planning, generating, validating, and assembling scroll-driven landing pages. It includes a dependency-free CLI, mock mode, and a server-side KIE.ai adapter.
defaultPrompt: Turn this website into a cinematic landing page.
Create a CineLanding project from these assets.
Validate this CineLanding project before generation.
